title: Bryony
summary: BRY'ONY, noun [Latin bryonia.] White jalap; a genus of plants of several species. The root of the rough or white bryony is a strong irritating cathartic. Black-bryony is a genus of plants, called Tamu

inlines.v: BRY'ONY, noun [Latin bryonia.] White jalap; a genus of plants of several species. The root of the rough or white bryony is a strong irritating cathartic. Black-bryony is a genus of plants, called Tamus.
